title: Moff Gideon
description: "A friendly piece of advice," Moff Gideon told the Mandalorian, "assume that I know everything." The brilliant leader of a contingent of the Imperial Remnant was bent on creating an army of Force-sensitive clones to help him destroy the New Republic and reinstate the glory of the Empire. One thing he didn't know was how the Mandalorians would unite against him.
